title.zh: 宣布每年 7 月 1 日为东达沃、南达沃与北达沃省的公共假日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring July First of Each Year as a Public Holiday in the Provinces of Davao Oriental, Davao Del Sur, and Davao Del Norte
title.orig: An Act Declaring July First of Each Year as a Public Holiday in the Provinces of Davao Oriental, Davao Del Sur, and Davao Del Norte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6380_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: July first of each year is hereby declared a public holiday in the Provinces of Davao Oriental, Davao del Sur and Davao del Norte.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, August 16, 1971.
